lines.en: scene imaniclassintro1
Another day begins and, lo and behold, Imani storms into class and immediately usurps my role as “most important person in the room.”
lines.zh: 新的一天开始了，你瞧，Imani 冲进教室，立刻就篡夺了我「房间里最重要的人」的位置。

lines.en: But hey, she brought me coffee from the teacher’s lounge so, as far as I’m concerned, she can do whatever she wants for pretty much the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，她从教员室给我带了咖啡，所以在我看来，今天剩下的时间里她爱干嘛干嘛。

lines.en: Sure, I imagined that we’d kind of ease into her intro instead of just letting her walk to the front of the room and start teaching a bunch of girls who have likely forgotten by now how school is supposed to work-
lines.zh: 当然，我本来以为我们会慢慢过渡、先做个介绍，而不是直接让她走到教室前面，开始给一群大概早就忘了学校该怎么运作的女孩上课——

lines.en: But it’s not like this changes my itinerary at all. In fact, it even takes some of the pressure off of me in that I can now hang out with the girls like I’m some sort of oversized, middle-aged high school student.
lines.zh: 但这丝毫没有改变我的日程安排。事实上，它甚至替我卸下了一些压力——现在我可以像某种超大号的中年高中生一样，跟女孩们一起混了。

lines.en: I hope the new teacher asks me to stay after class.
lines.zh: 希望这位新老师会让我课后留下来。

lines.en: : Knowledge! Or, as I like to call it, {i}the key to knowing stuff...{/i}is the third most important thing to fill your body with.
lines.zh: : 知识！或者说，我喜欢这么称呼它——{i}「知道东西的钥匙」{/i}……是填满你身体的第三重要的东西。

lines.en: : The first of which is water, since us humans are comprised of roughly 75ish%% of it-
lines.zh: : 排在第一的是水，因为我们人类大约有 75ish%% 是由它构成的——

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro2
: And the second?
lines.zh: : 那第二呢？

lines.en: Imani pauses for dramatic effect, but everyone seems to be more confused than anything else.
lines.zh: Imani 停顿了一下，制造戏剧效果，但大家看起来更多的是困惑。

lines.en: : The second...
lines.zh: : 第二……

lines.en: : Is friendship.
lines.zh: : 是友谊。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro3
: Excuse me. I have a question.
lines.zh: : 不好意思。我有个问题。

lines.en: : Yes! Ask me anything you’re curious about! I’m a repository of useful information!
lines.zh: : 好！你有什么好奇的尽管问！我是有用信息的仓库！

lines.en: : Pardon my language but, who the hell do you think you are?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，你他妈以为你是谁啊？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro4
: Woah there, Makoto! Ya can’t just go around askin’ teachers stuff like that! Not everybody’s as forgiving as Sensei is!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，Makoto！你可不能就这么到处跟老师这样讲话！不是谁都像老师那么好脾气的！

lines.en: : We haven’t even confirmed if she’s an actual teacher yet. For all we know, she could be some random woman who just waltzed into class with a desire to {i}try it out.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们甚至都还没确认她是不是真老师呢。说不定她只是个随便晃进教室、心血来潮想{i}试试看{/i}的女人。

lines.en: : But...I coulda sworn I heard ya talkin' about how she was the stand-in for Miss Watabe the other-
lines.zh: : 可是……我明明记得前几天听你说过，她是 Watabe 小姐的代课——

lines.en: : Teaching’s no small task, Miku. It’s not something a person can just decide they want to do one day.
lines.zh: : 教书可不是小事，Miku。这不是一个人某天一拍脑袋决定想干就能干的。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro5
: Okay but like...do they {i}have{/i} to decide that? Cause I feel like our normal teacher hasn’t even gotten to that point yet.
lines.zh: : 好吧可是……他们真的{i}非得{/i}决定吗？因为我觉得我们那位正牌老师到现在都还没走到那一步呢。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Sensei just has unshakeable faith in me as a student and has decided to take the backseat in actual instructing so that I have more room to grow.
lines.zh: : 胡说。老师只是对我这个学生有着不可动摇的信心，所以才决定在实际教学上退居二线，好给我更多成长的空间。

lines.en: Oh, Makoto. I thought you were smarter than that.
lines.zh: 哦，Makoto。我还以为你比这聪明呢。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro6
: Hey, I get the frustration. It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out you might just think I’m some random woman who got lost and started scribbling things on a chalkboard.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们的挫败感我懂。不用火箭科学家也能猜到，你们大概觉得我是个迷了路、然后在黑板上乱写乱画的随便哪个女人。

lines.en: : You didn’t even figure that out. You’re just paraphrasing what I said to my friend just now.
lines.zh: : 你连这都没猜到。你只是在复述我刚才跟我朋友说的话。

lines.en: : What is your name, child?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字，孩子？

lines.en: : I’m not a child!
lines.zh: : 我不是孩子！

lines.en: : What is your name, not-child?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字，非孩子？

lines.en: : I’m...hah. Makoto Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 我是……哈。Makoto Miyamura。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro7
: Ahh, so {i}you’re{/i} the one who was brought up at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 啊，{i}你{/i}就是女仆咖啡厅里提到的那位啊。

lines.en: : Maid cafe? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 女仆咖啡厅？你在说什么？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro8
: What’s the issue here, Makoto? Is this more of a “Don’t interfere with how my favorite teacher does things” problem? Or a “You’re stealing my job” problem?
lines.zh: : 问题出在哪儿呢，Makoto？是那种「别来干涉我最喜欢的老师做事的方式」的问题？还是「你在抢我饭碗」的问题？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro9
: It’s an “I don’t even know who you are” problem. I didn’t hear anything from Sensei or the principal about a new teacher, and I {i}always{/i} hear about things like this before they happen.
lines.zh: : 是「我根本不知道你是谁」的问题。不管是老师还是校长，我都没听说要来新老师，而这种事我{i}总是{/i}在发生之前就听说的。

lines.en: : Apparently not! Because I’ve known about this all week and Sensei’s known about it for like, twelve hours or something.
lines.zh: : 显然这次没有！因为这事我都知道整整一星期了，而老师知道大概才十二个小时什么的。

lines.en: : Are you a student teacher, then? Is that what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 那你是实习老师吗？是这么回事？

lines.en: : And, if that’s the case, shouldn’t you maybe...introduce yourself before telling us to put {i}friendship{/i} into our bodies? Like, how would that even work?
lines.zh: : 如果是这样，你是不是该先……自我介绍一下，再叫我们把{i}友谊{/i}放进身体里？比如说，那到底要怎么做啊？

lines.en: : Yeah. I love Makoto, but I don’t really know how I feel about her gettin’ all up in my body, new teacher lady.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我爱 Makoto，但我可不确定自己受不受得了她往我身体里钻，新老师女士。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro10
: To whom it may concern! Which...I guess is all of you.
lines.zh: : 致相关人士！也就是……我想是你们所有人。

lines.en: : My name is Imani Imai and I’m going to be your new student teacher.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Imani Imai，将是你们的新实习老师。

lines.en: : You don’t have to call me Sensei or anything since that would probably get confusing really fast.
lines.zh: : 你们不用叫我老师之类的，因为那很快就会把人搞混。

lines.en: : In fact, you don’t even have to treat me like a teacher if you don’t want to! I’m of the belief that minds are better molded when done so on a casual, informal level.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果你们不想，甚至不用把我当老师对待！我相信，在随意、非正式的层面上，思想更容易被塑造。

lines.en: : I’ve been sent here to keep you guys up to snuff on education stuff, while also keeping the school off of Sensei’s back for extremely understandable reasons!
lines.zh: : 我被派到这里，是为了让你们在学业上不掉队，同时也是为了让学校别再盯着老师不放——原因非常好理解！

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro11
: Are you getting fired, Sensei? Because this teacher just seems like a better, cuter version of you so far.
lines.zh: : 你要被开除了吗，老师？因为这位老师到目前为止，看起来像是个更好、更可爱的版本的你。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d compare her to {i}me{/i} just yet. But, at least from what I figured out yesterday, she’s not exactly an average teacher either.
lines.zh: : 我还不确定该不该把她跟{i}我{/i}相提并论。不过，至少从昨天我摸清的情况来看，她也不是什么普通的老师。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Well, the first time she came into my office, she accused Miss Watabe and me of “fucking” each other.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她第一次进我办公室的时候，就指控 Watabe 小姐和我在「搞」彼此。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro12
: Oh my god. {i}Are{/i} you? Does Nodoka know?
lines.zh: : 哦我的天。你们{i}在搞{/i}吗？Nodoka 知道吗？

lines.en: : Wait, was Nodoka {i}there?{/i} Did all three of you-
lines.zh: : 等等，Nodoka {i}当时也在{/i}吗？你们三个都——

lines.en: : No, Rin.
lines.zh: : 没有，Rin。

lines.en: Not yet, at least.
lines.zh: 至少目前还没有。

lines.en: : Why would...she assume something like that?
lines.zh: : 她为什么会……假定出那种事？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro13
: Because she’s weird? I don’t know what you want me to say here.
lines.zh: : 因为她很怪？我不知道你想让我说什么。

lines.en: : She’s already taken over the room and she’s only been here for five minutes. She’s clearly a force to be reckoned with.
lines.zh: : 她已经接管了整个教室，而她才来了五分钟。她显然是个不容小觑的狠角色。

lines.en: : You just...seem to know her pretty well for...someone you just met...
lines.zh: : 你只是……对一个刚认识的人……似乎了解得挺清楚的……

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro14
: Hm.
: I guess that’s not entirely incorrect.
lines.zh: : 我想这也不算全错。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll all be saying the same thing about her soon enough, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我相信，你们很快就会对她有同样的看法了。

lines.en: : Just look at Makoto, she’s already coming to terms with it.
lines.zh: : 看看 Makoto，她已经在接受现实了。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro15
: Listen! All I’m saying is that it’s not wrong for me to doubt the legitimacy of this without seeing your papers!
lines.zh: : 听着！我想说的只是：在没有看到你的证件之前，我怀疑这件事的正当性并没有错！

lines.en: : Woah there! You already taking shots at my heritage, Makoto?! I’ll have you know I’m a legal citizen of Japan, thank you very much!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，慢着！你已经开始拿我的血统开涮了吗，Makoto？！我可要告诉你，我是日本的合法公民，非常感谢！

lines.en: : Your {i}assignment{/i} papers! I couldn’t care less about your citizenship paperwork!
lines.zh: : 我说的是你的{i}委派{/i}文件！你的公民身份文件我才一点也不在乎！

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro16
: Which brings us right to today’s discussion- dual citizenship! Thank you, Makoto, for the excellent segue!
lines.zh: : 这就正好引出了今天的讨论——双重国籍！谢谢你，Makoto，这个过渡太棒了！

lines.en: : It wasn’t a segue! And why is this your choice for a first lesson in our class?!
lines.zh: : 那才不是过渡！还有，你为什么选这个作为我们班的第一课？！

lines.en: : So, now that we have an actual topic to go off of, how about we dive in a little deeper?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然我们终于有个像样的话题了，不如再深入一点？

lines.en: : I figure that just having one good discussion every morning is a much better way of getting you guys to learn stuff than forcing you to read textbooks and all that junk.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，每天早上好好讨论一次，比逼着你们读课本那些破烂玩意儿更能让你们学到东西。

lines.en: : Oooh! I’m sorry, Makoto, but I’m startin’ to like her! She’s speakin’ my language all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 哦哦！抱歉啊，Makoto，但我开始喜欢她了！她突然讲起我的语言了。

lines.en: : So, dual citizenship...what is it?
lines.zh: : 那么，双重国籍……它是什么？

lines.en: : Well, just as the name implies, it’s when one person is registered as a legal citizen in two separate countries or states or- you know, basically, just two different places.
lines.zh: : 嗯，正如名字所示，就是一个人同时在两个不同的国家、州，或者……你知道的，基本上就是两个不同的地方，登记为合法公民。

lines.en: : But Japan is actually one of the few nations that {i}doesn’t{/i} recognize dual citizenship.
lines.zh: : 但日本其实是少数{i}不{/i}承认双重国籍的国家之一。

lines.en: : This means that mixed people like me are forced to choose one before we turn 22.
lines.zh: : 这意味着像我这样的混血儿，必须在 22 岁之前选择其中一个。

lines.en: : So...does that mean you legally count as 100%% Japanese now? I don’t think I’m understanding the...legality of this rule.
lines.zh: : 那是不是说，你现在在法律上算是 100%% 的日本人了？我不太明白这条规则的……合法性。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro17
: Great question and nice to meet you! What’s your name?
lines.zh: : 好问题，也很高兴认识你！你叫什么名字？

lines.en: : Futaba...Fukuyama.
lines.zh: : Futaba……Fukuyama。

lines.en: : Well, Futaba, I don’t blame you for not understanding the rules since they’re pretty inconsistent and nonsensical, but I’ll try to break down a few more aspects of it for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Futaba，这些规则前后不一致又毫无逻辑，你不理解也怪不得你，不过我试着再给你拆解几个方面。

lines.en: : I’m 100%% Japanese on a strictly legal basis because I was forced to surrender my Ghanaian nationality in order to count as a full citizen here.
lines.zh: : 在严格的法律意义上，我是 100%% 的日本人，因为为了在这里算作完整公民，我被迫放弃了加纳国籍。

lines.en: : Well, {i}forced{/i} probably isn’t the right word since it was something I chose to do, but still! Surrendering a nationality you’re born with is just one of several ways to legally {i}become{/i} Japanese.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}「被迫」{/i}大概不是恰当的词，因为那是我自己的选择，但即便如此！放弃一个你与生俱来的国籍，只是合法{i}成为{/i}日本人的几种方式之一。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro18
: Foreign adults can acquire that nationality by living in the country for over five years, whereas adopted children from foreign countries only have to live here for one.
lines.zh: : 外国成年人可以通过在本国居住五年以上获得该国籍，而从外国被收养的儿童只需在这里住满一年。

lines.en: : It works in reverse, too. For example, if I registered for dual citizenship in Ghana, a country that allows it, I would automatically {i}lose{/i} my Japanese nationality despite being a current citizen.
lines.zh: : 反过来也一样。比如说，如果我在加纳——一个允许双重国籍的国家——登记双重国籍，尽管我现在是日本公民，也会自动{i}失去{/i}日本国籍。

lines.en: : What a world we live in! Where the country we live in can just decide we’re not a real citizen anymore because we want to exist in two places at once.
lines.zh: : 我们活在一个什么样的世界啊！我们居住的国家，竟然可以仅仅因为我们想同时存在于两个地方，就决定我们不再算是真正的公民。

lines.en: : So! Do we have anyone else from mixed backgrounds here? Or am I just going to stick out even more than I already do?
lines.zh: : 那么！这里还有别的混血背景的人吗？还是说我要比现在更显眼了？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro19
: I’m kind of zoning out because this discussion is boring, but I just wanna say right now that I really want to fuck the new teacher.
lines.zh: : 我有点走神了，因为这个讨论很无聊，但我现在就想说一句：我真的很想操这位新老师。

lines.en: : You want to fuck every teacher, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你想操每一位老师，Kirin。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro20
: Well, I mean...not {i}every{/i} teacher...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我是说……也不是{i}每一位{/i}老师……

lines.en: : Just...the two that are in this room.
lines.zh: : 只是……这间屋子里的那两位。

lines.en: : I’d probably be down to let Miss Watabe dom me too since I’ve heard she’s into that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我大概也愿意让 Watabe 小姐支配我，因为我听说她好这口。

lines.en: : Wakana? Yeah, I can see that.
lines.zh: : Wakana？嗯，我看得出来。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro21
: Hey! How about we make a deal? You can get the new teacher and I can get Sensei!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我们做个交易怎么样？你拿下新老师，我拿下老师！

lines.en: : Then, when I’m no longer able to suppress the aggressive hormones raging inside of my body, we can have hot group sex every Friday night.
lines.zh: : 然后，当我再也压制不住体内汹涌的荷尔蒙时，我们可以每周五晚上来一场火辣的群交。

lines.en: : Does it even count as “group sex” if it’s just two couples fucking each other in the same room?
lines.zh: : 如果只是两对情侣在同一个房间里互相操，那还能算「群交」吗？

lines.en: : Is it a group of people?
lines.zh: : 有一群人吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Is there sex?
lines.zh: : 有性吗？

lines.en: : Uhh, yeah.
lines.zh: : 呃，有。

lines.en: : Well, then that should answer all of your questions.
lines.zh: : 那这就该回答你所有的问题了。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro10
: Okay! There’s the bell!
lines.zh: : 好啦！铃响了！

lines.en: : Everybody get ready for gym class! Unless you’re too embarrassed to change in front of others or just...don’t want to or something!
lines.zh: : 大家准备上体育课！除非你不好意思当着别人的面换衣服，或者就是……不想换什么的！

lines.en: : I don’t know! Do whatever it is you normally do when the real teacher is leading the class!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！正牌老师上课的时候你们平时干嘛，就干嘛吧！

lines.en: : I’m going to go find a burrito somewhere!
lines.zh: : 我要去找个墨西哥卷饼吃！

lines.en: : Class dismissed!
lines.zh: : 下课！

lines.en: scene black
Imani rushes out of the classroom and is quickly followed by a bunch of girls who still don’t understand if she’s really going to stick around or if this was just a long, elaborate joke.
lines.zh: Imani 冲出教室，一群女孩立刻跟了出去——她们还是没搞明白，她是真的会留下来，还是这只是个又长又精心设计的玩笑。

lines.en: One notable student {i}does{/i} wind up sticking around after everyone else leaves, though.
lines.zh: 不过，有一个值得一提的学生，在其他人走光之后{i}留了下来{/i}。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro22
: Maya? What’s up?
lines.zh: : Maya？怎么了？

lines.en: : Are you here to tell me some secret about another cycle coming to a close or something like that?
lines.zh: : 你是来告诉我，又一个循环即将结束之类的秘密吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m here to remind you of another Secret Santa exchange so you don’t wind up disappointing some other girl the way you disappointed me last Christmas.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是来提醒你还有一场 Secret Santa 交换的，免得你又像去年圣诞节让我失望那样，让哪个别的女孩失望。

lines.en: : Wait, did I actually disappoint you?
lines.zh: : 等等，我真的让你失望过吗？

lines.en: : Of course. But you disappoint me every single day, so I didn’t think it was a particularly big deal.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过你每天都让我失望，所以我不觉得这是什么特别的大事。

lines.en: : Well first off, I apologize for existing.
lines.zh: : 首先，我为我的存在道歉。

lines.en: : It’s okay. I forgive you.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我原谅你。

lines.en: : Second, how do you know about this year’s Secret Santa? I thought everything happening was {i}new{/i} to you now.
lines.zh: : 第二，你怎么知道今年这场 Secret Santa 的？我以为现在发生的一切对你来说都是{i}新的{/i}。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro23
: Because it’s been written on the board for two weeks and you were asleep when we drew names.
lines.zh: : 因为它已经写在黑板上两个星期了，而你抽名字的时候在睡觉。

lines.en: : You’re not very observant, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不太善于观察，是吧？

lines.en: : Not about things I’m not particularly interested in, no.
lines.zh: : 对我不感兴趣的事，是不太善于，没错。

lines.en: : So, who do I have this year?
lines.zh: : 那么，今年我抽到了谁？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro24
: Not a clue. But we shoved the only unclaimed slip of paper into your podium earlier this morning before our new...student teacher showed up?
lines.zh: : 一点头绪都没有。不过在今天早上我们那位新……实习老师出现之前，我们把唯一那张没人认领的纸条塞进了你的讲台。

lines.en: : How do you feel about that, by the way?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，你对此有什么感想？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro25

: I feel as though I may be forced to actually learn something for the first time in a very, very long time. And I worry that my hands may no longer remember how to hold a pencil for any tests assigned to us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，我可能会在非常、非常长的时间之后，第一次被迫真的去学点东西。而且我担心，我的手可能已经不记得该怎么握笔，去应付分配给我们的任何考试了。

lines.en: : Well, you sure knew how to hold one when you filled a fake journal with information on yourself and all of your-
lines.zh: : 嗯，你往一本假日记里写满关于你自己和所有你那些——的时候，握笔倒是握得挺熟的。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro24
: I’m leaving now. I’ll see you later tonight.
lines.zh: : 我要走了。今晚见。

lines.en: : Wait, tonight?
lines.zh: : 等等，今晚？

lines.en: : I’m sleeping over for the mini Christmas party we’re having at your house.
lines.zh: : 我们要在你家办迷你圣诞派对，我要过去留宿。

lines.en: : How do you know about all of these things without secret knowledge from the future?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会在没有来自未来的秘密知识的情况下，知道所有这些事？

lines.en: : Because I talk to people about things other than just sex and boobies.
lines.zh: : 因为我会跟人聊性和咪咪以外的事情。

lines.en: : Anyway, bye.
lines.zh: : 总之，拜。

lines.en: : Make sure that whatever present you decide to buy for the person unfortunate enough to be assigned to you isn’t one that will get immediately tossed into the trash.
lines.zh: : 记得，不管你最后给那个不幸被分给你的可怜人买什么礼物，都别是那种会立刻被扔进垃圾桶的东西。

lines.en: : Thanks, Maya. I’ll make sure to pick up a separate present for you too and-
lines.zh: : 谢了，Maya。我一定会也单独给你挑一份礼物，然后——

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro26
: Okay. Good talk.
lines.zh: : 好的。聊得真愉快。

lines.en: scene black
scene imaniclassintro27
Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: Well, at least it’s not Maya this time.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少这次不是 Maya。

lines.en: But what the hell am I supposed to buy for Miku?
lines.zh: 可我到底该给 Miku 买什么啊？

lines.en: I don’t think it’ll be {i}too{/i} hard since I know she likes...soccer and...running and stuff- but neither of those things sound like they’d make particularly exciting gifts.
lines.zh: 我觉得应该不会{i}太{/i}难，毕竟我知道她喜欢……足球啊……跑步啊之类的——但这俩听起来都不像什么特别让人兴奋的礼物。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I’ll probably just wait until the last minute and choose whatever I can find.
lines.zh: 我大概会拖到最后一刻，随便挑个能找到的东西。

lines.en: Or, if I’m really struggling, just get her a gift card or something.
lines.zh: : 或者，实在没辙的话，就给她张礼品卡什么的。

lines.en: I don’t care what anyone says about how gift cards are {i}impersonal{/i} or bad gifts or anything.
lines.zh: 别人怎么说礼品卡{i}没诚意{/i}、是烂礼物，我一点都不在乎。

lines.en: Nothing says “I care about you” more than trusting someone with the free will to make their own decisions rather than making one for them, in my opinion.
lines.zh: 在我看来，没有什么比「把自由意志交托给别人、让他们自己做决定，而不是替他们决定」更能表达「我在乎你」了。

lines.en: But, this is clearly no time for an inner debate like that since I’m now acutely aware that someone {i}else{/i} is standing in front of my desk.
lines.zh: 不过，现在显然不是做这种内心辩论的时候，因为我已经清楚地意识到，还有{i}另一个人{/i}正站在我的课桌前。

lines.en: if ayane_lust >= 20:
scene imaniclassintro28
: Surprise Ayane visit! Time to love me!
lines.zh: : 惊喜 Ayane 拜访！该爱我了！

lines.en: : You need to stop skipping gym class to come and see me. People are going to realize what your game is.
lines.zh: : 你别再为了来见我而翘体育课了。别人迟早会看出你的把戏。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro29
: Everyone’s known my game since the start, Sensei! I’m like the Ami that people won’t think is weird for liking you so much since you and me aren’t {i}actually{/i} related.
lines.zh: : 从一开始大家就知道我的把戏了，老师！我就像是那个不会因为太喜欢你而被觉得奇怪的 Ami，毕竟我们俩并没有{i}真的{/i}血缘关系。

lines.en: : So, what’s up then? If this is about the Secret Santa thing, Maya just reminded me.
lines.zh: : 那么，怎么了？如果是 Secret Santa 的事，Maya 刚提醒过我了。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro30
: Well...it’s not about that. But it is {i}kind of{/i} a present, I guess?
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是那件事。不过它大概算是{i}某种{/i}礼物吧？

lines.en: : I just wanted to give you a sneak peek of something so I could get your thoughts on it before everyone else sees it.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你先偷偷看一眼，好在其他人看到之前听听你的想法。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro31
: Plus, we haven’t really been spending any time in school {i}alone{/i} lately and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 而且，最近我们在学校里基本没怎么{i}独处{/i}过，而且……嗯。

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard to find alone time when I’m surrounded by an ever-increasing number of girls.
lines.zh: : 当身边围着越来越多的女孩时，想找时间独处确实挺难的。

lines.en: : So, what is it you wanted to show me?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想给我看什么？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro32
: Well, I’m not going to just {i}tell{/i} you! That would ruin the surprise!
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不会直接{i}告诉{/i}你！那会毁了惊喜的！

lines.en: : You’ll have to follow me if you want to see it!
lines.zh: : 你想看的话，就得跟我来！

lines.en: : Then...lead the way, I guess?
lines.zh: : 那么……请带路？

lines.en: scene black

else:
scene imaniclassintro33
: Oh, Io. What’s up? Hiding from the rest of the girls again?
lines.zh: : 哦，Io。怎么了？又在躲其他女孩？

lines.en: : Something like that...
lines.zh: : 差不多吧……

lines.en: : Did you need something?
lines.zh: : 你需要什么吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’m trying to figure out how to say it in a way that doesn’t sound annoying or cringeworthy or like...lame? Weird? I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，但我在想该怎么说，才能听起来不烦人、不尴尬，也不……逊？怪？我不知道。

lines.en: : Well you’re already off to a rocky start, but that’s basically what I’ve come to expect from you by now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这开头已经够坎坷的了，不过这基本就是我对你的一贯预期了。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro34
: Okay, so...hypothetically, if a girl that liked you made you a Christmas present and wanted to give it to you, would you rather she be honest about it? Or would that come off as like...overbearing?
lines.zh: : 好吧，就是……打个比方，如果一个喜欢你的女孩给你做了份圣诞礼物、想送给你，你更希望她坦诚一点吗？还是说那样会显得……太强势？

lines.en: : If this is about me coming over to see what you made for me after school, I already planned on it.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的是放学后我过去看你给我做了什么，我已经打算去了。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro35
: What? How did you know about that?
lines.zh: : 什么？你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Uta told me yesterday when I went to the maid cafe with Imani and Wakana.
lines.zh: : 昨天我陪 Imani 和 Wakana 去女仆咖啡厅的时候，Uta 告诉我的。

lines.en: : Was she...not supposed to do that?
lines.zh: : 她……是不该说出去吗？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro36
: Uta did?...Huh. That’s weird.
lines.zh: : Uta 说的？……嗯。真奇怪。

lines.en: If I’m remembering correctly, I’m pretty sure Uta said that Io {i}asked{/i} her to tell me about it, too- which I’m suddenly realizing was probably not the case.
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，我很确定 Uta 当时说，是 Io {i}让{/i}她来告诉我的——而我突然意识到，大概根本不是这么回事。

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro37
: So...Uta aside, you’ll come then?
lines.zh: : 那么……抛开 Uta 不谈，你会来的吧？

lines.en: : I will.
lines.zh: : 我会。

lines.en: : And you won’t think I went way overboard when you see what I made?
lines.zh: : 而且你看到我做的东西时，不会觉得我做得太过了吧？

lines.en: : Well...I mean, that kind of depends.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说，那得看情况。

lines.en: : I’m sure that as long as I can carry it home, whatever you made will be fine.
lines.zh: : 我相信，只要我还能把它搬回家，你做的什么都没问题。

lines.en: : And if you can’t carry it home?
lines.zh: : 那要是搬不回家呢？

lines.en: : Io, what did you make me?
lines.zh: : Io，你给我做了什么？

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro38
: A-Anyway! See you later! And remember that you can always regift stuff if you don’t like it and I won’t blame you at all since I definitely went way overboard!
lines.zh: : 总、总之！回头见！还有记住，你要是不喜欢，随时可以转送别人，我绝对不会怪你，因为我确实是做得太过了！

lines.en: : Io, what did you-
lines.zh: : Io，你到底做了什——

lines.en: scene imaniclassintro39
: Nothing! Bye!
lines.zh: : 没什么！拜！

lines.en: scene black
Well, looks like my first Christmas present of the year might wind up being a little more than I bargained for.
lines.zh: 看来，我今年的第一份圣诞礼物，可能会比我预想的要超出一点。

lines.en: Which, need I remind you, was absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 而提醒一下，我预想的是完全没有。

lines.en: But hey, if Io wants to bust her ass making some sort of crazy gift for me, she can feel free.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，如果 Io 想拼了老命给我做某种疯狂的礼物，她尽管做好了。

lines.en: Here’s hoping that it provided at least some sort of distraction for her.
lines.zh: 希望那至少给她提供了某种消遣。

lines.en: And here’s hoping that I didn’t accidentally get Uta in trouble by revealing I knew about this gift from the get go.
lines.zh: 也希望我没有因为一上来就暴露自己早就知道这份礼物，而无意中把 Uta 惹上麻烦。
